items.title: Affine étale covers of Spec k are finite étale k-algebras
items.statement_scope: Whole Lemma 1.2.3: let k be a field. Suppose f: X → Spec k is an étale map of spectral Deligne-Mumford stacks. If X is affine, then X ≃ Spec k′ for some étale k-algebra k′.

standard_prerequisites: Étale sheaves on CAlg_k^et identify with sets carrying a continuous action of the absolute Galois group.
Finite separable extensions of k and finite coproducts of their spectra.
Quasi-compactness of the affine spectral Deligne-Mumford stack Spec k and its étale covers.
items.difficulty_reason: Rule author-work-bearing-core-v1-20261114: H2 because the proof at author PDF p. 12 is a concrete finite-étale descent argument: it writes X = Spec A, chooses a separable closure, identifies étale sheaves on CAlg_k^et with sets carrying continuous Galois action, shows U is a discrete G-set, decomposes it into finite separable extensions kα, and uses quasi-compactness to make the coproduct finite. This is non-routine research material but a supporting lemma, not the H3 main comparison.

difficulty_evidence.bearing_core: Galois-descent classification of affine étale covers of Spec k as finite étale k-algebras.
